entries.en: to shout at him; to call out to him loudly
entries.notes: L 栏有残，H「整濁伊」与 dar voces/gritos 之喊叫义不合，姑据 L 定夺，存疑。

entries.en: to strike hard; a heavy blow
entries.notes: L 疑读作 dar con fuerça（用力）＋porrazo（重击）；H「擬」与 M tīm／R chīm 音义均不合。

entries.en: to beat the breast with a clenched fist
entries.notes: L 明言以拳击胸；H 栏「捱」与 M tūy／R chūi（搥）不合，疑原字为「搥胷」。

entries.en: to strike the chest, the upper part of the breast

entries.zh: 张开手掌拍打自己的胸口，示哀痛或悔罪
entries.en: to strike one's breast with the open hand, in grief or contrition
entries.notes: H 栏标〔疑:捨/撻〕，据 R tā（撻）与 L「张开手掌」取「撻胸」。

entries.en: to give alms; to relieve the poor
entries.notes: M 作两音节 chîn chèy，疑词头本为「賑濟」而 H 栏仅存「濟」。

entries.en: to give alms; to relieve
to give alms; to bestow charity
to butt with the head, like a ram
entries.notes: H「擠」与 M quiā guiū／R ỷ 不能互证，仅 L 的羊抵义明确。

entries.zh: 配给口粮、分发一份食粮
entries.en: to give out a ration; to serve a portion of food
entries.notes: M 末尾有残，H「閔」与 cuān hiūn 音不合；仅 L ración 一义可据。

entries.zh: 给客人送礼，百般应承款待
entries.en: to give gifts to a guest; to gratify a guest in every way

entries.zh: 割舍、勉强给出（舍不得而给）
entries.en: to part with reluctantly; to give grudgingly

entries.zh: 宴席散时给受邀宾客发钱
entries.en: to give money to the invited guests as the feast breaks up
entries.notes: H「拆席」与 R chēg dȳ 不能对齐，暂据 L 与「拆席（散席）」定夺。

entries.zh: 席散时给受邀宾客发钱；拆乾（席终饮尽）
entries.en: to give money to the invited guests; to break up the feast with the cups drained
entries.notes: L 与上条全同而 H 作「拆乾」，二字之别未详，并列存疑。

entries.zh: 射、投命中目标；做出头（居首、出入头地）
entries.en: to hit the mark in shooting; to come out foremost
entries.notes: M、R 两栏并有 T99 污损；「做出頭」与「命中」非同一义，两存之。

entries.en: to forward; to send on to another
entries.notes: L 栏残损难读，H/M/R 三栏一致作「轉寄」，义可推定。

entries.zh: 为乐曲打拍子、定节拍（起调）
entries.en: to beat time for the music; to set the pitch
entries.notes: M 有残、M/R 并有 T99，据 H「拍位」与 L 推之。

entries.zh: 凭表记为凭、以标记作凭证
entries.en: to go by a token or mark as proof
entries.notes: L 栏残损不可读，仅 H/M/R 三栏支持「憑表記」。

entries.en: to give thanks; to return thanks
to hold a knife in front of someone
entries.notes: L 残损；H「把盡」与 pè choâ／pā chīn 及刀义均不合，存疑。

entries.en: to give thanks; to thank
entries.notes: R 栏 pōn siē 与第 19 条重复，疑串行；H/M/L 三栏一致。

entries.en: to give thanks afterwards; to make up one's thanks
